$comment: Transcription of the official MCP reference filesystem server (@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem) in tools/list shape. Tool names, input properties and required fields follow the published server; shared $defs (FilePath/TextContent) are used so the data flow between tools is typed, and outputSchema gives the structured form of what the server returns as text. Scopes added by Waypoint (fs:read / fs:write).

tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text. DEPRECATED: use read_text_file for text files and read_media_file for binary content.
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file. Use the head parameter to read only the first N lines, or tail for only the last N lines.

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file.

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file.

tools.name: read_text_file

tools.description: Read a media or binary file and return its contents as base64 data together with its MIME type.
tools.name: read_media_file

tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. This is more efficient than reading files one by one when you need to analyze or compare multiple files. Each file's content is returned together with its path. Failed reads for individual files do not stop the whole operation.
tools.name: read_multiple_files

tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Handles text content with proper encoding. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: write_file

tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content. Returns a git-style diff showing the changes made. Only works within allowed directories.

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format without applying them.

tools.name: edit_file

tools.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation. Succeeds silently if the directory already exists. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: create_directory

tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: list_directory

tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path, including file sizes. Results distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes and can be sorted by name or size. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: list_directory_with_sizes

tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Each entry includes its name, type (file/directory) and children for directories. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: directory_tree

tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Can move files between directories and rename them in a single operation. Fails if the destination already exists. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: move_file

tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a glob pattern. Returns the full paths of all matching files and directories. The search is case-insensitive and matches partial paths. Only searches within allowed directories.
tools.name: search_files

tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory: size, creation time, last modified time, access time, type (file or directory) and permission flags. Only works within allowed directories.
tools.name: get_file_info

tools.description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access. Use this to understand which directories are available before trying to access files.
tools.name: list_allowed_directories
